dct_title_s: Antigua, particulars of two valuable Sugar Estates : called "Hawes," and "Mercer's Creek," both situate in the Parish of St. Peter and Division of Mercer's Creek, in the Island of Antigua, and containing together 309 acres, or thereabouts : which will be sold by auction, in one lot, by Messrs. Hards, Vaughan, & Leifchild, before James Fleming, Esq. Q.C., and Reginald John Cust, Esq., Commissioners for sale of Incumbered Estates, in the West Indies, at the Sale Room of the Commissioners
